Customize your playstyle with our brand new
Unlock skills as you level up to enhance towers, economy, defense, and strategy.
Each category features unique upgrades with branching progression paths.
New HUD: Refactored the in-game HUD to improve readability and clarity.
Icons: View your currently active skills in-game via new HUD icons.
Improved Gunpowder: Boosts AOE explosion radius.
Fight Dirty: Extends enemy debuff duration.
Precision: Every X shots deal a 1.5x critical hit (non-stacking).
Resourcefulness: More cash from selling towers.
Bigger Budget: Start with increased cash.
Scavenger: Double kill rewards every X kills.
Accelerator: Reduces cooldowns for active skills.
Expanded Barracks: Shorter cooldown for spawning units.
Re-enforcements: Raises the tower placement limit.
Fortify: Boosts the player's health pool (uses highest HP in groups).
Extreme Conditioning: Shortens duration of enemy debuffs/stuns.
Beefed Up Minions: Increases summoned unit health.
Over-Heal: Retain more HP from overhealing.
Bandages: Automatically regenerate HP at the start of each wave.
